done_when: Approving a candidate-backed memory review saves the memory; the review card reports the real outcome (approved, failed with reason, or already decided); a Postgres test covers approving a candidate-backed review end to end

dismissals.because: apps/core/test/integration/memory-review-card-decisions.postgres.integration.test.ts:203 drives clicks through the production message-action router with real Postgres and the real memory service, faking only the Slack client; passes host-side 3/3; the owner approved dismissing the running-app/browser test for this fix on 2026-09-29

findings.body: The required running-application end-to-end test is missing. These tests use real Postgres and the production message-action router, but `click()` invokes a captured Slack callback with a handcrafted payload and asserts captured `chat.update` arguments. They never start the application/API or exercise a browser flow through Playwright, so they cannot verify production registration or the visible card interaction. Add the required running-application test with real Postgres, faking only third-party edges, that verifies candidate-backed approval persists the memory and the card displays approved, failed-with-reason, and already-decided outcomes.
